verdict.rationale: Segment documents a Profile API that lets an agent programmatically read user and account traits, events and external_ids. It also documents a versioned, token-authenticated Public API with an OpenAPI spec for workspace CRUD. However, the listed Public API resources are Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans, and nothing shows audiences being created or activated via API. No MCP server is evidenced (llms.txt also returns 404). Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating and activating Engage audiences, an official MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free end-to-end agent workflow.
